[P2] Preserve terminal failure identity through enclosing contexts

When an invoke inside `runInChildContext` stops with `errorType = "States.Stopped"`, this branch names the invoke `InvokeStoppedException`. However, `ChildContextOperation.handleChildContextFailure` copies the original error object into its context checkpoint and reconstructs a `ChildContextFailedException`; this exporter therefore names the enclosing context and execution `Stopped`. The same propagated failure now has different names, whereas previously all three retained `States.Stopped`. Preserve the SDK terminal-error identity through context checkpointing and replay, and add nested stop/timeout scenarios to the integration coverage.
